<?php

class DnsPacket {
    public $id;
    public $questions = [];
    public $answers = [];
    public $flags;
    
    public static function parse(string $raw): self {
        $pkt = new self();
        $pkt->id = (ord($raw[0]) << 8) | ord($raw[1]);
        $pkt->flags = (ord($raw[2]) << 8) | ord($raw[3]);
        $qdcount = (ord($raw[4]) << 8) | ord($raw[5]);
        $ancount = (ord($raw[6]) << 8) | ord($raw[7]);
        
        $offset = 12;
        for ($i = 0; $i < $qdcount; $i++) {
            $name = self::readName($raw, $offset);
            $qtype = (ord($raw[$offset]) << 8) | ord($raw[$offset + 1]);
            $offset += 4;
            $pkt->questions[] = ['name' => $name, 'type' => $qtype];
        }
        for ($i = 0; $i < $ancount; $i++) {
            $name = self::readName($raw, $offset);
            $rtype = (ord($raw[$offset]) << 8) | ord($raw[$offset + 1]);
            $offset += 2;
            $rclass = (ord($raw[$offset]) << 8) | ord($raw[$offset + 1]);
            $offset += 2;
            $ttl = (ord($raw[$offset]) << 24) | (ord($raw[$offset+1]) << 16) |
                   (ord($raw[$offset+2]) << 8) | ord($raw[$offset+3]);
            $offset += 4;
            $rdlength = (ord($raw[$offset]) << 8) | ord($raw[$offset + 1]);
            $offset += 2;
            $rdata = substr($raw, $offset, $rdlength);
            $offset += $rdlength;
            $pkt->answers[] = [
                'name' => $name, 'type' => $rtype, 'class' => $rclass,
                'ttl' => $ttl, 'rdata' => $rdata
            ];
        }
        return $pkt;
    }
    
    private static function readName(string $raw, int &$offset): string {
        $labels = [];
        $jumped = false;
        $maxJumps = 5;
        $jumpCount = 0;
        $savedOffset = null;
        
        while (true) {
            $len = ord($raw[$offset]);
            if (($len & 0xC0) === 0xC0) {
                if (!$jumped) $savedOffset = $offset + 2;
                $ptr = (($len & 0x3F) << 8) | ord($raw[$offset + 1]);
                $offset = $ptr;
                $jumped = true;
                $jumpCount++;
                if ($jumpCount > $maxJumps) break;
                continue;
            }
            if ($len === 0) {
                $offset++;
                break;
            }
            $offset++;
            $labels[] = substr($raw, $offset, $len);
            $offset += $len;
        }
        if ($savedOffset !== null) $offset = $savedOffset;
        return implode('.', $labels);
    }
}

class ConnectionPool {
    private $sockets = [];
    private $pending = [];
    
    public function getSocket(string $server, int $port): $socket {
        $key = "$server:$port";
        if (!isset($this->sockets[$key])) {
            $this->sockets[$key] = stream_socket_client("udp://$server:$port");
        }
        return $this->sockets[$key];
    }
    
    public function registerPending(int $txid, string $queryName): void {
        $this->pending[$txid] = $queryName;
    }
    
    public function getPendingQuery(int $txid): ?string {
        return $this->pending[$txid] ?? null;
    }
    
    public function removePending(int $txid): void {
        unset($this->pending[$txid]);
    }
}

class DnsResolver {
    private $cache = [];
    private $pool;
    private $server;
    private $port;
    
    public function __construct(string $server = '8.8.8.8', int $port = 53) {
        $this->pool = new ConnectionPool();
        $this->server = $server;
        $this->port = $port;
    }
    
    public function resolve(string $hostname, int $type = 1): ?string {
        $cacheKey = $this->getCacheKey($hostname, $type);
        if (isset($this->cache[$cacheKey])) {
            $entry = $this->cache[$cacheKey];
            if ($entry['expires'] > time()) {
                return $entry['value'];
            }
            unset($this->cache[$cacheKey]);
        }
        
        $txid = random_int(0, 65535);
        $packet = $this->buildQuery($hostname, $type, $txid);
        $socket = $this->pool->getSocket($this->server, $this->port);
        
        $this->pool->registerPending($txid, $hostname);
        fwrite($socket, $packet);
        
        $response = $this->readResponse($socket, $txid);
        if ($response === null) return null;
        
        $this->processResponse($response);
        
        if (isset($this->cache[$cacheKey])) {
            return $this->cache[$cacheKey]['value'];
        }
        return null;
    }
    
    private function readResponse($socket, int $expectedTxid): ?DnsPacket {
        stream_set_timeout($socket, 5);
        $raw = fread($socket, 512);
        if ($raw === false || strlen($raw) < 12) return null;
        
        $pkt = DnsPacket::parse($raw);
        if ($pkt->id !== $expectedTxid) {
            return null;
        }
        return $pkt;
    }
    
    private function processResponse(DnsPacket $pkt): void {
        $queryName = $this->pool->getPendingQuery($pkt->id);
        $this->pool->removePending($pkt->id);
        
        foreach ($pkt->answers as $answer) {
            $answerName = strtolower($answer['name']);
            $cacheKey = $this->getCacheKey($answerName, $answer['type']);
            $value = $this->formatRdata($answer['type'], $answer['rdata']);
            $ttl = min($answer['ttl'], 86400);
            
            $this->cache[$cacheKey] = [
                'value' => $value,
                'expires' => time() + $ttl
            ];
        }
    }
    
    private function validateAnswerBelongsToQuery(string $answerName, string $queryName): bool {
        $queryLabels = explode('.', strtolower($queryName));
        $answerLabels = explode('.', strtolower($answerName));
        
        // Check if answer is for the queried domain or a parent zone
        $queryZone = implode('.', array_slice($queryLabels, -2));
        $answerZone = implode('.', array_slice($answerLabels, -2));
        
        return $answerZone === $queryZone;
    }
    
    private function getCacheKey(string $name, int $type): string {
        return strtolower($name) . '/' . $type;
    }
    
    private function formatRdata(int $type, string $rdata): string {
        if ($type === 1 && strlen($rdata) === 4) {
            return inet_ntop($rdata);
        }
        return bin2hex($rdata);
    }
    
    private function buildQuery(string $hostname, int $type, int $txid): string {
        $header = pack('n6', $txid, 0x0100, 1, 0, 0, 0);
        $question = '';
        foreach (explode('.', $hostname) as $label) {
            $question .= chr(strlen($label)) . $label;
        }
        $question .= "\x00";
        $question .= pack('n2', $type, 1);
        return $header . $question;
    }
    
    public function getCache(): array {
        return $this->cache;
    }
}
